shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && ls -R .agents/skills/gravity-ui | head -50 && echo ---- && cat AGENTS.md && echo ---- && ls && cat package.json

find src -type f | head -50 && echo ---- && for f in $(find src -type f); do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done && echo ---- && cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts && echo ---- && ls __agent_eval__ 2>/dev/null | head

rg -n -i -C 3 "dropdown|menu|action" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80; echo ----; rg -n -C 4 -i "Button view|Icon data" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -80

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit DropdownMenu Button Icon 2>&1 | head -60; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons 2>&1 | head -3

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit DropdownMenu Button Icon 2>&1 | head -60; echo ----; node -e "const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json');console.log(p.version, 'deps icons:', p.dependencies?.['@gravity-ui/icons'], 'peer icons:', p.peerDependencies?.['@gravity-ui/icons'])"; node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json').version)"; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/ 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && curl -sS -m 20 -L "https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt" -o /tmp/uikit7.txt; echo "exit=$? size=$(wc -c </tmp/uikit7.txt 2>/dev/null)"; head -c 300 /tmp/uikit7.txt; echo; echo ----; rg -n -i -m 60 "dropdownmenu|renderSwitcher" /tmp/uikit7.txt | head -60; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/MenuItem.d.ts | head -60

node -e "fetch('https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt',{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(15000)}).then(r=>r.text()).then(t=>{require('fs').writeFileSync('/tmp/uikit7.txt',t);console.log('ok',t.length)}).catch(e=>console.log('FAIL',e.message))"; echo ----; rg -n -i -C 2 "renderSwitcher|## DropdownMenu|# DropdownMenu" /tmp/uikit7.txt 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo ----; rg -n -i -C 6 "required setup" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -60

timeout 90 npm install @gravity-ui/icons@^2.23.1 --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; grep -n icons package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -E "^(ChevronDown|Pencil|Copy|TrashBin|ArrowDownToLine|Link)\.d\.ts$"

rg -n "variant\?|color\?" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; rg -n "TEXT_VARIANTS|body-1" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -5; rg -n "TEXT_COLORS|secondary" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -5; rg -n "size\?|view\?" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -4
timeout 180 npm run build 2>&1 | tail -12; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; git status --short
